attribution.title: Palace on the Dam
attribution.author: City of Amsterdam, Geo- en Vastgoedinformatie
attribution.modifications: Cleaned up for the web, not changed artistically: SketchUp construction edges removed, faces made double-sided so inward-facing normals stop rendering black, spare UV sets and tangents dropped, textures re-encoded as WebP, geometry quantized and meshopt-compressed. Placed at the city's own published coordinate at its surveyed size, unscaled and unrotated.

attribution.title: Centraal station
attribution.author: City of Amsterdam, Geo- en Vastgoedinformatie
attribution.modifications: Cleaned up for the web, not changed artistically: SketchUp construction edges removed, faces made double-sided so inward-facing normals stop rendering black, all materials set non-metallic (they arrive at glTF's default metallicFactor 1.0, which renders black with no environment map), unpainted faces darkened from SketchUp's near-white, spare UV sets and tangents dropped, textures re-encoded as WebP, geometry quantized and meshopt-compressed.
